# Security policy

## Scope

This repository is an unused copy of the Mintlify Starter Kit. It is not deployed and contains
no DualMind code or data. The live DualMind Arena docs come from
[dualmindlabs/arena-docs](https://github.com/dualmindlabs/arena-docs).

You can still use the channels below to report a security problem in any DualMind Labs product:
the docs at [docs.dualmindlab.tech](https://docs.dualmindlab.tech), the Arena at
[arena.dualmindlab.tech](https://arena.dualmindlab.tech) or the API at
[api.dualmindlab.tech](https://api.dualmindlab.tech/health).

## Reporting a vulnerability

> [!CAUTION]
> Please do **not** report security problems in a public issue, pull request or discussion.

**Preferred: GitHub private vulnerability reporting.** Open a private report at
[Security → Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/dualmindlabs/docs/security/advisories/new).
Only the maintainers can see it.

**Or by email:** write to [support@dualmindlab.tech](mailto:support@dualmindlab.tech) with the
subject line `Security: <short summary>`.

Please include what you found and where, steps to reproduce it, the impact you expect, and your
name or handle if you would like credit.

## What happens next

| When | What |
|---|---|
| Within 3 working days | We confirm we received your report |
| Within 10 working days | We share our assessment and a plan |
| After the fix ships | We tell you, and credit you if you want |

Please give us a reasonable chance to fix the problem before you discuss it publicly.
